decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - .
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Before commencement of operations, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following matters:
(i)	any external illumination of the site
(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; and
(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties.
The scheme so approved should be fully implemented.

Condition : 7 - The academic space hereby approved shall be used for D1 "non residential" University Education" and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 8 - With respect to any condition that requires the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority, the works thereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with that approval unless subsequently otherwise approved in writing by that Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 9 - There shall be a minimum 2.0m clearance in plan between the building and any part of the M4 elevated viaduct.
Condition : 10 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the building hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the LPA.
Condition : 11 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior written approval of the LPA.

Condition : 12 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 13 - Any A3 use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 14 - Any A3 use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 15 - The scheme approved under condition 13 (Ventilation equipment - details) shall be fully implemented before the A3 use opens to customers.
Condition : 16 - The scheme of ventilation approved under Condition 13 (ventilation equipment - details) shall be fully implemented before the use is commenced.
Condition : 17 - The A1/A3 use hereby permitted shall not be carried on outside the following times 9.00am to 11.00pm weekdays (Monday-Friday) and Saturday, and 11.00am to 11.00pm on Sundays.

Condition : 18 - The academic use of the building at first and second floors shall not commence before the ground floor level shopfront/s are completed unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 19 - Notwithstanding Condition 3, detailed drawings of the ground floor level shopfront/s shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.

Condition : 20 - The A1/A3 use hereby permitted shall be confined to sales to customers attending the premises, and shall not extend to the delivery of food or drink to customers by vehicle unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 21 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to all the building shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
description: Following planning permission (01217/C/P27) in December 2004 for Thames Valley University, proposal to alter three-storey Building H of the approved scheme for retail space and education use by changing the footprint and positioning it further from the boundary with 1000 Great West Road
